title: Three sessions ending with the same error raise one incident card and one attention line, and clear after 30 minutes
description: The real control plane seeds three work items whose implementation sessions ended with the same error carrying different commit hashes: master status raises one repeated-failure attention line naming the normalised error, 3 items and 'the caretaker is looking', Home renders one repeated-failure incident card with the same facts, and both clear once the 30-minute window passes.

steps.name: repeated failure incident in master status and on Home
